lessons.title: 1. Float Division vs Floor Division
lessons.description: Python supports floating-point division `/` (which returns a decimal) and floor division `//` (which rounds down to the nearest integer).

lessons.title: 2. The Modulo Operator (%)
lessons.description: The modulo operator `%` returns the remainder of division. For example, `10 % 3` is `1`.

lessons.title: 3. Currency Exchange (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Calculate currency exchanges using division, modulo, and floor division.
learning_objectives: Perform float division and floor division with //
Calculate remainders using the modulo % operator
Work with currency rates and spread percentages
